children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on eClerx Services

We attended eClerx's ‘Investor Day’, where Management presented its growth strategy across service lines, products integration across workstreams, and a telescopic view of the business amid the developments in AI. KTAs: 1) eClerx is positioning itself toward domain expertise + tech + data + analytics + AI, with limited exposure to low-end, easily automatable work and a more annuity-like revenue mix. 2) It continues to deepen and broaden client relationships, reflected in the 2.5x growth in cross-sell deal wins, >80% of top-50 clients expanding into new areas, and a 2x acceleration in large-deal wins. 3) It aspires to become a $1bn enterprise, with ample growth runway across existing businesses, productized services, selected adjacencies, and AI-led opportunities. 4) Roll-offs remain at ~15–20% and are largely driven by project/client requirement rather than AI-led displacement or delivery-related issues. 5) eClerx delivered healthy shareholder returns across timeperiods, with 65%/49% of profit returned in FY17–21/FY22–26. Management continues to target top-quartile growth, while maintaining EBITDAM within the 24-28% band, with growth taking precedence over near-term margin as it continues to invest in sales, capabilities, AI, and geographic expansion. We remain constructive on eClerx’s medium-term growth prospects, backed by consistent growth (FY23-26 revenue/EBITDA CAGR of ~16%/13%), steady earnings, and strong execution.

Considering all these factors, we raise our target multiple to 18x (from 16x) and roll-forward TP to Sep-28E EPS, incorporating the latest AR data and revised currency assumptions. We retain REDUCE, while raising our TP by ~18% to Rs2,000 from Rs1,700.
